_comment: Facts about this adapter that its probe response cannot carry: display names, maturity, and the engine versions CI actually restores from. Everything the probe declares (adapter version, engine id, source kinds, pitr) is read from testdata/probe_response.golden instead — never duplicated here. The official semitechnologies/weaviate images pin /bin/weaviate as their entrypoint AND the binary ignores unknown positional arguments (measured 2026-09-03), so under `command: sleep infinity` the stock image starts a serving engine on defaults instead of idling; the suite runs the two-line wrapper the adapter README documents, built FROM the listed image, so the server exercised is exactly the listed version's. The image is Alpine with busybox sh, wget and nc — no bash, no curl — which is what the check runner speaks. Under --network none the engine needs CLUSTER_ADVERTISE_ADDR pinned to loopback (measured: the memberlist layer otherwise finds no private IP and refuses to start), and without DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true it POSTs to telemetry.weaviate.io at startup (measured). The vendor supports the latest three minor lines with a rolling policy and publishes no per-version end-of-life dates, so supported_until is null and versions_checked records the reading. See docs/capabilities.md and docs/engine-versions.md.
